verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows send customized meeting lifecycle messages and reminders, with configurable timing and templates meant to minimize no-shows. Steps follow reschedules and are called off on cancellation, and workflows can auto-attach to every new link, so they fire around every booking. Email reminders come from the host's own address, and actions can run at a set time before or after a meeting. missing for 10: any documented SMS/text reminder channel, explicit documentation of post-meeting follow-up message sequences (only implied via timing before/after), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows

citations.quote: Customize your timing and content to minimize no-shows. Compose from scratch or pick one of our handy templates.
Customize the timing and content of your reminders to increase attendance.
Reschedule, and the steps still to come move to the new time. Cancel, and they're called off.
Turn on "Automatically attach to new links," and every link you create from then on picks it up.
Confirmations and reminders come from you, not us
It’s never been easier to send customized meeting lifecycle messages and automate manual tasks with SavvyCal workflows.
